headline: Sri Lanka stocks trend up 0.56-pct, driven by LOLC, DCSL
summary: Sri Lanka's stock market advanced 0.56%, with gains led by LOLC Holdings and Distilleries Company of Ceylon (DCSL). PGP Glass and Access Engineering were also positive contributors.
why: The All Share Price Index (ASPI) tracks the Colombo Stock Exchange, the benchmark for Sri Lankan equities. Moves in its largest companies shape sentiment for the island's frontier-market investors.
